<p align="center"><strong>Ending 01 of 06 - The Unfinished Visit</strong></p>


<p align="center">You reach the road as the town clock strikes twelve. Briar House vanishes. The key remains in your hand, tied to a ribbon bearing next Halloween's date.</p>

<p align="center">At home, your porch pumpkin turns toward the door. From inside it comes Ada's whisper: &quot;You left us.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">THE UNFINISHED VISIT - You escaped. The names are still trapped, and the house knows where to send its next invitation.</p>
